key_insight: Aes3D provides the first targeted aesthetic-assessment framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting, predicting human-aligned aesthetic scores from multi-view renders to evaluate composition, harmony, and visual appeal beyond reconstruction fidelity.
problem_solved: Existing 3D evaluation focuses on fidelity and realism but neglects higher-level aesthetic attributes (composition, harmony, visual appeal) for 3DGS; there was no dataset, metric, or benchmark tailored to aesthetic assessment of 3D splatted scenes.
method: Curate a human-annotated dataset of 3DGS scenes with multi-view rendered images and aesthetic ratings to form a dedicated Aes3D benchmark.
Train a multi-view aggregation model that extracts per-view features and fuses cross-view information to predict a global aesthetic score aligned with human judgments.
Validate with user studies and correlation/ranking analyses, showing stronger agreement with human preferences than standard fidelity metrics.
impact: Provides tools and benchmarks for creators and researchers to measure and optimize visual appeal in 3DGS workflows, enabling aesthetic-aware rendering, automated curation, and research into aesthetic-driven 3D content generation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: dataset → multi-view renders → feature extraction → cross-view fusion → aesthetic score
Side-by-side examples: low vs high aesthetic 3DGS renders to illustrate target attributes (composition, lighting, harmony)
Scatter plot: predicted aesthetic score vs human ratings (with correlation coefficient)
Dataset summary chart: distribution of ratings and scene categories
paper_title: Aes3D: Aesthetic Assessment in 3D Gaussian Splatting
paper_authors: Chuanzhi Xu, Boyu Wei, Haoxian Zhou, Xuanhua Yin, Zihan Deng
